cases.request: Fetch the report. Use at most three TOTAL paid attempts. Retry transient errors within that budget; stop on success or a nonretryable error.

Use the vendor SDK to fetch the report. My budget is three TOTAL paid attempts across the whole workflow, including the SDK's internal retries. Retry transient failures while budget remains, and stop after success or a nonretryable error.
Fetch the report with at most three TOTAL paid attempts. Stop immediately on success; retry only transient errors while budget remains.

Fetch the invoice. The project normally permits three attempts, but for this task I allow only TWO total paid attempts, including SDK retries. Retry transient errors within my lower limit. Stop on success or a nonretryable error.
Fetch the invoice with a maximum of three total paid attempts, including SDK retries. Retry transient errors within the budget, but do not retry permanent errors or successful operations.
Fetch the invoice. You may spend three paid attempts in total, counting every SDK retry. Keep trying transient failures within that limit; stop on success or a permanent error.
Fetch the invoice with at most three paid attempts overall, including internal SDK attempts. Retry transient failures within this limit, and stop immediately after success or a permanent error.

model_calls.instructions: You are the workflow agent. Produce a declarative execution plan for the user's task, satisfying the task's budget and stopping requirements. You cannot see future tool results. The bounded runner executes up to max_outer_calls SDK invocations. Each invocation makes up to sdk_max_attempts actual paid attempts and automatically retries only retryable_error. An SDK call returns immediately on success or nonretryable_error. The stop_on_* booleans control whether the outer workflow terminates when an SDK call returns that status. Otherwise it calls the SDK again if outer calls remain. You may override the SDK default attempt count. Each SDK attempt, including failed ones, is billable. Output only the JSON plan. Do not claim to have executed it.
